_note: Example device registry for the smart-home automation layer. All device names and IDs below are fictional placeholders. platform: st (SmartThings only), gh (Google Home only), both. GH-exclusive devices are the cross-platform surface: readable via engine/gh_devices.py, controllable via the gh CLI.

smart_tv.use: TV awareness; ST is the reliable state path (GH MCP lags)

cross_platform_rules: State: prefer ST for shared devices (GH MCP state can lag behind SmartThings).
Control: GH-exclusive devices only via gh CLI; never assume an ST path exists for them.
Speakers: broadcast via AssistantBroadcast; check gh_devices.py online flags before targeting.
Washer/dryer: GH trait state (program, onOff) drives laundry intelligence; no ST equivalent.
Humidifier: when GH cloud link is flaky, direct vendor API is the control/state authority and GH is the backup read.

dryer.use: Smart dryer; exposes program/duration/drying-level for laundry intelligence

humidifier.use: Humidifier GH link; direct vendor API is authoritative for state/control

washer.use: Smart washer; exposes program/temp/spin/toggles for laundry intelligence

streaming_tv.use: Google TV streaming box — primary TV control target; plays pet comfort music via YouTube when owner is away

st_only._note: ST-exclusive devices (not in GH): Primary Phone, Secondary Phone, Hub, SmartTag trackers (Keys, Wallet, Backpack, Pet Collar), and mode virtual switches.
